label: class_f_06_dragon_01
text: Hello, class! It is I, Hassel, yet again.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_02
text: First, allow me to apologize for losing my\ncomposure during our last class...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_03
text: I was so touched by Brassius’s story that I simply\ncouldn’t contain my emotions. I’m sorry for\r\nmaking such a scene.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_04
text: I certainly got a very stern talking-to from\nMs. Tyme after that class, yes...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_05
text: Anyway, let us shift gears and dive into the\nmaterial for today’s class![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_06
text: Now, have any of you heard of the Ten Sights\nof Paldea?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_07
text: As the name would imply, they are ten sights in\nPaldea that are considered particularly beautiful.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_08
text: Among them, I would say that the[VAR 0xFF00(0006)] Grand Olive[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Orchard[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] is likely the most accessible.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_09
text: You can see field after field of olive trees from\nthe hill on the way to Cortondo.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_10
text: Two waterfalls are also counted among these\nten sights—[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Fury Falls[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] and [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Casseroya Falls[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_11
text: Then there’s the peak of Glaseado Mountain,\nknown as [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Paldea’s Highest Peak[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_12
text: There’s another cliff on Glaseado Mountain that’s\nnamed after its rather unique shape.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_13
text: So, let me ask you, my students![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_14
text: What is the name of the three-pronged cliff on\nGlaseado Mountain? No need to grasp at straws![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_select_01
text: Glaseado’s Grasp

label: class_f_06_select_02
text: Glaseado’s Reach

label: class_f_06_select_03
text: Glaseado’s Run

label: class_f_06_dragon_answer_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Exactly! It looks like a hand taking hold of\nsomething, doesn’t it, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_answer_02
text: A very good guess! I’d think something reaching\nwould stretch out farther, though.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_answer_03
text: A unique take! But that sort of name would\nusually apply to a slope, don’t you think?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_15
text: The three-pronged cliff on Glaseado Mountain\nis in fact known as [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Glaseado’s Grasp[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_16
text: Though its shape is far too stubby to be that\nof a human hand. I imagine someone thought it\r\nlooked like a Pokémon hand grabbing something.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_17
text: There’s also the mountains in Area Three of the\nEast Province, where you can get a good look at\r\nLevincia. It’s particularly gorgeous at night![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_18
text: In fact, the view is so brilliant, it is known as the\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Million Volt Skyline[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_19
text: I hear it’s quite a hotspot for dates—and\ndeservedly so for having such a romantic view![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_20
text: I imagine it’s...what do the kids say these days...\na very, ahem, “fleek selfie spot”?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_21
text: Of course, you may feel that not all ten sights live\nup to their grandiose names. How often do we\r\nvisit some tourist spot only to be disappointed?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_22
text: Not to say that you shouldn’t visit them, only\nthat you should keep your hopes in check.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_23
text: The important thing is to go yourself and see\nthem with your own two eyes.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_24
text: And sometimes, a disappointing experience can\nbe worthwhile in its own way. Take a chance![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_06_dragon_25
text: Well, that’s it for today, class. Thank you for\nyour attention![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
